label: DFRobot pool chemistry — SEN0711 pH + SEN0712 chlorine via Dragino
notes: Standard pool chemistry-only monitor: DFRobot SEN0711 ammonia/pH probe (Modbus slave 1) + SEN0712 residual chlorine probe (slave 2) on one RS485 bus → Dragino RS485-NB. Default 4800 8N1 per DFRobot wiki. Set unique probe addresses (reg 0x07D0) before wiring both. Tags: PH_PV, CL_PV, WATER_TEMP_C, NH3_MG_L — bind to pool_chemistry HMI composite. Cloud: POST /api/parc/dragino-gateway/bind-preset presetId dfrobot_pool_chemistry_dragino, then /plan. Single-probe local RS485: dfrobot_sen0711_ammonia_ph / dfrobot_sen0712_chlorine.
